case_number: 2023INSC783; Civil Appeal No 2844 of 2011 with multiple connected appeals
summary: Void/voidable marriage under Hindu Marriage Act; legitimacy of children; Section 16 analysis; ancestral vs. self-acquired property rights; joint Hindu family; Mitakshara coparcenary; conflict between Jinia Keotin, Neelamma, Bharatha Matha and Revanasiddappa; constitutional equality considerations; statutory interpretation for children's property rights; reference to larger bench for conflicting precedents.
legal_provisions_cited: Jinia Keotin v Kumar Sitaram Manjhi
Bharatha Matha v R Vijaya Renganathan
final_judgment: Reference referred to larger bench for reconsideration of precedents regarding property rights of children born from void/voidable marriages.
